notes.title: Roadmap to Neoverse by Official Launch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34165603/002beb3968b5ac96be80b0cfffeea2cf56bcdfd8.jpg[/img]
We share a roadmap for content to be developed during the remaining Early Access period.

[h1]Permanent wearable equipment[/h1]
We're creating content that allows you to add 3 additional equipment to each character. You'll be able to purchase them with the honorary goods you acquire during the play. Each piece of equipment will be able to play a different game, and a different combination of equipment will be able to create its own mode and explore Neoverse in more different ways.

[h1]Story[/h1]
We're currently working on a way to share Neoverse's worldview and story. Based on this, we'll connect you to the Progress chapter to experience the true beginning and end of Neoverse.

[h1]New Chapter and True Boss[/h1]
We're working on a wider range of monsters and true Final Boss chapters. The new combination will give you more fun.

[h1]infinite mode[/h1]
We are preparing to enjoy the current "Hunter Mode" indefinitely. It will be a mode of endless challenge to a stronger combination of enemies that is constantly becoming stronger.

[h1]JoyPad and Keyboard Operation[/h1]
We're now preparing to complement our deficient operation and enjoy it in a more diverse and convenient way.

In fact, September's balance patch was designed to create a stronger balance for these additional contents. Before we could add a variety of content, we needed to have a firm grip on our existing balance. There may be unfamiliar parts with the balance and rhythm of the play that are different from what you used to play, but our developers think that the current balance is necessary for a variety of fun with new contents. And of course, it's going to be more refined as well.

We're working on a lot more than that, but we're going to have other parts after the official launch, which we're going to give you.

Thank you again to the players who are still with Neoverse, and please give us a lot of feedback for better Neoverse.

notes.title: Cataclysm: Major Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34165603/5ff86345196f46adb57db0ee0e8e0e952449845c.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]To make it easier to play and enjoy a deeper strategy, our development team has made big changes to the overall game balance.[/b][/h1]

The overall changes include:
[list]
[*] For better balance and fun, basic mechanisms such as Radioactivity, Overheat, Faith, Vampiric State, Command, and Guardians have been completely reinvented.
[*] To reduce the inconvenience and fatigue caused by relatively large numbers, we have worked on controlling the numerical inflation of all cards, skills and monsters.
[*] Each card and skill has been modified to have more characteristic performance.
[*] Monsters have been modified to have more different patterns.
[*] Excessive supply of skill points has been limited for the strategic fun of building a skill tree.
[*] The entire stage was reduced to 15 but each time the balance was adjusted to make it even more tense.
[*] Eliminated or modified unnecessary or redundant elements of the Battle UI.
[/list]
These modifications have made the overall difficulty higher than in the past, but they have a better balance, allowing us to go deeper into various strategies.

[i]Please give us a lot of feedback on the completely new Neoverse. We will continue to work hard for journey in the Neoverse, which includes more fun and suspenseful with your opinions.

notes.title: Balance Works v0.947
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34165603/3b260e09ae4f0b9352ff09e592b6fddeeb779ba2.png[/img]

[h1]Based on the user data, Balance work of Clare’s cards with the lowest clearance rate is preceded. We have improved the difficulty of deck growth due to poor damage early in the game and focused on mitigating high cost cards and difficult card conditions. For a more complete balance, we will continue to make corrections and we will announce all the details through patch notes.[/h1]

[list]
[*] Clare's "Punishment" changed from buff to neutral effect. No longer 'Punishment' will be removed by monsters' abilities removing buff.

[h1][i][b](x) is the factor that the card is evolved.[/b][/i][/h1]
[*] Attack: Attack damage 5 (8)> 6 (9) Remove additional damage when Vampiric state
[*] Powerful Prayer': Attack Damage 10 (11)> 12 (12), Faith 1> 2
[*] Holy Strike: Attack Damage 8 (10)> 10 (15)
[*] Evangelism: Attack damage 8 (11)> 10 (13)
[*] Planned Prayer: Attack damage 6 (8)> 8 (12)
[*] Family Foe: Attack damage 9 (12)> 5 (8), cost 2 (2)> 1 (1)
[*] Kill Heretic: Attack damage 20 (30)> 20 (20), Cost 2 (2)> 1 (1), Unstable (Unstable)> Unstable (Consume)
[*] Cruel Battle: Cost 2 (1)> 1 (0)
[*] Oath of Blood : Attack damage 2 (5)> 5 (8), additional damage in Vampiric state 8 (10)> 5 (7)
[*] Force of Faith: Cost 4 (3)> 3 (2)
[*] Firm Prayer: Cost 4 (3)> 3 (2)
[*] Betrayal: Cost 1 (1)> 0 (0), Attack damage 14 (16)> 8 (10)
[*] Constant prayer: Cost 2 (2)> 1 (1), Faith 2 (3)> 1 (2)
[*] Divine Generosity: Cost 5 (4)> 3 (2)
[*] Divine Protection: Cost 4 (3)> 3 (2), Remove the condition ‘Remove all Faith points and deactivate Vampiric state’
[*] Will of God: Remove the condition ‘Remove all Faith points and deactivate Vampiric state’
[*] Absolute Faith: Cost 4 (3)> 3 (2)
[*] Prayer of Salvation: Remove the condition ‘Remove all Faith points and deactivate Vampiric state’

[*] The voice of Naya getting armor has been removed. 

[/list]
